hook.name: BinHook V2
hook.description: Bin-based AMM (Liquidity Book / DLMM style) on a Uniswap v4 pool. Liquidity sits in discrete price bins, held as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager. The hook fills every swap in beforeSwap and returns the full delta, so the pool's own liquidity stays zero. LPs add and withdraw through the hook and hold shares per bin. LP fee: a fixed base fee plus an optional volatility surcharge. Uniswap's protocol fee is passed on at the PoolManager's rate. No owner, not upgradeable, hookData ignored.
